about: IconVault Originals is the first exclusive icon set designed in-house for IconVault – 300 original icons drawn from scratch on a 24×24 grid in one consistent 2px rounded line style. It covers interface essentials, arrows, media, files, communication, weather, food, commerce, devices, transport, health and business – the everyday icons every website and app needs, all sharing the same stroke weight, corner radius and optical sizing so they look like one family at any size. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under ISC: free for personal and commercial use, no attribution required. This is set #1 – new original sets of 300 icons are released regularly.
